info.name: Snowflake Tag Value Refresh Refresh Tag Value Job API
Initiate a job to refresh a tag's allowed values.

items.docs: This endpoint initiates a tag value refresh job for a specified tag. It checks whether the provided tag exists or not and if the refresh job meets the necessary validation criteria. If all conditions are met, it triggers a refresh job and returns a job reference ID.

info.name: Get Tag Value Refresh Job Status

params.name: job-reference-id
params.description: The tag value refresh job reference ID

items.docs: Get a tag value refresh job status.
